horoscope: Mercury forms a square to Mars today, dear Aries, and with Mercury retrograde, there can be aggravation coupled with a lack of information. It's time to reconsider your plans and make sure they truly align with your deepest desires. This transit can aggravate ego issues. We may feel we are right and perhaps communicate too quickly under this influence. Aim to observe rather than act impulsively now. Some pressure may push you to make last-minute decisions, but you may not be fully equipped to make healthy ones right now. It's especially important to avoid cutting people off, and to be particularly careful when it comes to expressing yourself with a lover or with someone about an intimate or tricky matter. For example, one of you can be playful and tease, while the other takes things quite seriously. For best results, use that competitive energy to work on a productive project. Feeling on edge can be a difficult state to turn into a positive, but it's also entirely possible with determination. In many ways, it's a day to focus on home and family, your support system, personal matters, and long-term plans. If possible, try to dial things back a little for now.

With today's Mercury-Mars square, dear Taurus, it's wise to be careful about how and what you communicate. Aggravation is too easy to communicate now, and with Mercury retrograde, we may not have the full picture of a situation, which inclines us to draw the wrong conclusions. You may want to prepare for the need to adjust your schedule, as wires can get crossed today and plans can turn on their heads. This is not the best time for objectivity! While competition can motivate you to improve your game, tame defensiveness and impatience. Differences of opinion might be taken very personally today. The Moon is in your solar sector of communication and movement all day, and so you may also find yourself in motion, making connections, mingling, and perhaps a little scattered.

Today's Mercury-Mars square is a bit tricky, dear Gemini, particularly with retrograde Mercury in your nitpicky sixth house and Mars in your communication sector. There can be some agitation, so you might keep in mind that misunderstandings are highly likely now. People may not mean what they say or say what they mean! You could feel provoked or up in arms about a situation. Watch for hasty actions and reactions, particularly verbal ones, but also quick moves and decisions. Try not to succumb to pressure to make decisions, since not all the facts are in front of you. There is more to the story! Changes in your daily schedule can frustrate you but are likely necessary in the long run. With today's Moon, seek activities that ground you.

With today's Mercury-Mars square, dear Cancer, there may be delays or tension related to miscommunication. It may be all too easy to get thoroughly worked up over something that may not honestly matter in the long run. Try not to rush into making a statement or taking action, and consider that with Mercury retrograde, information before you is likely to be incomplete. If you use this competitive energy to improve your understanding of a situation or to step up your game, you are in a good place. Take extra care reaching conclusions and communicating. With the Moon in your sign all day, you might decide to take a personal inventory of any needs that you have buried, overlooked, or otherwise pushed out of view.

With today's Mercury-Mars square, dear Leo, you can feel tense, as if something is missing or out of place. You may feel bored with your routines, but be careful not to cause too much mischief because of these feelings, as they can invite conflict with others today. With Mercury retrograde, there can be a focus on past problems that now return. The temptation to push a matter or jump into action before you have all the facts is strong, but probably unwise right now. Dissatisfaction with the status quo can be at the heart of restlessness now, but take your time on a plan of action that will get you out of a rut. It may very well be that you're putting too much pressure on yourself. Concentrate on only the most critical tasks instead of spreading yourself too thin today for best results. The Moon transits your soul sector all day, bringing out a desire for some level of anonymity, withdrawal, and extra personal space or time to think.

With today's Mercury-Mars square, dear Virgo, the chance of tripping up runs high due to impatience or perhaps ego matters. You may want to avoid anger triggers if you can. Speaking too soon about an issue is not a good idea now. This transit can be, on the one hand, motivating if you need a push to step up your game, but frustrating on the other if pressure builds and you feel the need to make a hasty decision. There may be a frustrating problem from the past that hasn't been resolved that is nagging at you or even driving decisions. Don't expect others to read your mind today, even if you think the signals you're giving them are loud and clear. Ask for what you want instead, or wait until a better day to go after it. With the Moon in your solar eleventh house all day, a sector of the chart that rules our higher aspirations, the major key to emotional satisfaction or fulfillment right now may be to focus on those wishes and dreams dearest to your heart.

With today's Mercury-Mars square, things can easily get tense, dear Libra. Turning to others for stability could also lead to frustration. If you're facing unresponsiveness or defensiveness, wait for a better day to tackle major issues, as blockages are very likely right now. People seem to either be spilling too much or omitting important details. It's a good idea to avoid impulsive purchases, decisions, and communications. An issue surrounding values, money, or questions of ownership can be in focus. You can also be temperamental about whether others value and respect you. With Mercury retrograde involved, the information available now is likely incomplete, so you may want to wait to draw important conclusions until you have more facts and more patience! With today's Moon, life plan goals tend to be on your mind now, and so are your responsibilities.

With today's Mercury-Mars square, dear Scorpio, there's a tendency to rush things. If rushing makes you skip steps, try to slow down. While you might learn of something helpful that was previously hidden or private, it can be difficult to concentrate. Responsibilities and demands from others seem to be flying at you from all directions. A chaotic atmosphere can wear you down, so do what you can to take short breaks to get centered. While you could feel pressured to make a decision or a statement, it may be better to hold off doing so until you are in a more objective frame of mind. Since Mercury is retrograde in your sign and Mars is in your sector of career, authority, and rules, the tendency may be to resist others' wishes or to push an idea when people are too absorbed in their desires to give yours due consideration. You may be provocative now, whether you intend to be or not. Consider avoiding words you may later regret and conflicts with authority figures. Try not to feel pressured to take action when you're not fully aware of all the angles of a situation. Fortunately, today's Moon helps you loosen up and enjoy yourself. You might consider ways to release yourself from intense emotions.

Today's Mercury-Mars square is challenging, dear Sagittarius, and with Mercury retrograde, there can be some missteps. You might want to avoid making quick decisions or hasty conclusions right now. Objectivity can be difficult today, as information is likely missing or incorrect, or impatience clouds your ability to see the best course of action. Watch for being too adamant about your beliefs or for pushing an idea that others may not be ready for. Interactions with others can feel a little edgy, and differences of opinion can seem more glaring, hard to overlook, and problematic than they would be on another day. Fortunately, with the Moon in your solar eighth house, you are more inclined or able to get in touch with your innermost desires.

Today's tense aspect between Mars and retrograde Mercury can stir impatience, dear Capricorn. Consider that you may be putting too much pressure on yourself (and possibly others) to do things quickly. Pay extra attention to what you say and what you're doing since the chance of errors runs a little higher than usual. Let your ideas mature before sharing them, as criticism might weaken your motivation. Dreams are sometimes best kept to yourself until they take better form. You may not see things very clearly right now, and the same goes for others. The Moon spends the day in your house of "other", and you might feel pleasantly connected to someone special. The day favors openness to new ways of interacting.

Today's Mercury-Mars square can wind you and others up, dear Aquarius. Know your boundaries and enforce them today, and watch for decisions that aren't based on facts or that your gut tells you feel premature. Consider, too, that with Mercury retrograde, some information may be missing. You may not be seeing essential details and should probably be careful not to come on too insistently with authority figures or in professional dealings. It's best not to force issues. Irritability can strain partnerships if you or a partner doesn't know where to direct excess energy. Disagreements tend to come from rushing and impatience, so you might want to make a point of slowing down and aim not to jump to conclusions. You can also choose to let stressors motivate you to work on something on your own or to set your own pace, which can be satisfying. There is a strong need to keep busy today, with the Moon in your solar sixth house all day. You may feel more fulfilled if you handle problem areas and produce.

Today's Mercury-Mars square can increase the possibility of errors due to impatience, dear Pisces. Compounding this is Mercury's retrograde. Try to avoid speaking or acting hastily, as what we see now may be incomplete or misleading. This aspect can create an atmosphere of nervous tension. You might lose patience and feel pressured to make a decision. Of course, this can lead to positive things at times, such as finally taking action on a matter you left hanging, but it can also lead to hasty decisions or unnecessary arguments. Jumping into action before you have all the facts can be costly. Chances are that a difference of opinion can bother you more than it usually would because you feel rushed in other areas of life. For best results, ease up on the pressure and don't overload yourself with things to do. Today's Moon helps on this front, as it inspires you to enjoy yourself and loosen up.
